title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCES OF TAYABAS AND BOHOL FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE UNTIL OCTOBER FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCES OF TAYABAS AND BOHOL FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE UNTIL OCTOBER FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE.
title.vi: Đạo luật gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất năm 1905 tại các tỉnh Tayabas và Bohol đến ngày 1 tháng 10 năm 1905
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติขยายเวลาชำระภาษีที่ดินปี1905ในจังหวัด Tayabas และ Bohol ถึงวันที่1ตุลาคม1905
title.id: Undang-Undang yang memperpanjang batas pembayaran pajak tanah tahun 1905 di Provinsi Tayabas dan Bohol hingga 1 Oktober 1905
title.ms: Akta yang melanjutkan tempoh pembayaran cukai tanah tahun 1905 di Wilayah Tayabas dan Bohol hingga 1 Oktober 1905

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_01353_1905_html.txt

text.en:
The period for the payment, without penalty, of the; bind tax for the year nineteen hundred and
five in the Provinces of Tayabas and Bohol is hereby extended to October first, nineteen hundred and five.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, June 15, 1905.
